name: Lysis, RT, split, index PCR, pool and release chip
description: Lyses cells in capsules, reverse transcribes, splits into four portions for index PCR, pools them and releases the cDNA. Parametric parts: modules reaction_trap, split_2, pcr_1, pcr_2, pcr_3, pcr_4, pool_2, release_trap use the nearest library block as a stand-in (real part and sizing in autochip_part / params). build_chip.py builds the stand-ins at library size; the exact chip needs the autochip layout stage.

modules.does: Holds capsules on a 10 um mesh while lysis buffer and RT mix come in one after another on the shared reagent_line (swap the syringe between steps), with wash buffer flushes after lysis and after RT.
Splits the capsules into four sublibrary portions.
Portion 1: index PCR with its own index mix (PCR mix plus this lane's index primers).
Portion 2: index PCR with its own index mix.
Portion 3: index PCR with its own index mix.
Portion 4: index PCR with its own index mix.
Gathers the four differently indexed portions into one stream. The indexes allow pooling before clean-up, so the pooling step is done here.
Holds the capsules on a 10 um mesh while the shell-digesting enzyme releases the cDNA, which leaves through the main outlet. Capsule debris stays behind.

steps_text.14: Lyse the cells inside the capsules (placeholder time and temperature).
steps_text.16: Reverse transcribe the RNA inside the capsules (placeholder time and temperature).
steps_text.17: Wash the capsules after reverse transcription.
steps_text.18: Split the capsules into four sublibrary portions.
steps_text.19: Run index PCR on each sublibrary with its own index (placeholder cycles, times and temperatures).
steps_text.20: Release the cDNA from the capsules by digesting the shell with a shell-digesting enzyme (placeholder time and temperature).
steps_text.24: Pool the four cleaned-up sublibraries for sequencing.
